blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan has urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to send home Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan, who the senator described as “arrogant, insulting, crude and insolent.” Jing has been facing dissent from lawmakers after he claimed that China “may easily win” in a maritime confrontation, with resolutions in the Senate pushing for Jing to be declared as persona non grata, and some congressmen seeking the envoy’s expulsion. “Mr. President, if you can send Duterte, Quiboloy and Romualdez to jail, declare POGO illegal and have them shutdown, assert our sovereignty against Chinese aggression then you can most certainly […]... Keep on reading: Pangilinan urges Marcos to send ‘crude, insolent’ Chinese envoy home
